entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options
entities.description: Information element used to transmit protocol data such as configuration parameters, error codes, or messages/events from the network to the UE when supported by both ends for the PDN connection.

entities.name: Protocol data transmission to UE
entities.description: Procedure where the network transmits protocol data to the UE using extended protocol configuration options when supported by both UE and network.

entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options supported end-to-end
entities.description: Condition that both UE and network support extended protocol configuration options for the PDN connection.

relations.description: The protocol data transmission procedure includes the extended protocol configuration options IE when transmitting data to the UE.
The protocol data transmission procedure is guarded by the condition that extended protocol configuration options are supported by both UE and network.
